# Voice

Voice mod for Bedrock (Nukkit MOT).

**EN:** Voice mod for Bedrock (Nukkit MOT)  
**UK:** Войс мод для Bedrock (Nukkit MOT)  
**RU:** Войс мод для Bedrock (Nukkit MOT)

Author: **YehrLB**

## Parts

| Folder | What |
|--------|------|
| `VoiceMod/` | Nukkit MOT plugin (`/voice`) |
| `Android/` | Voice app for Android |
| `PC/` | Voice app for Windows/PC |
| `voice-server/` | Shared proxy for multi-server setups |

## Multi-server

Works on a single world **or** across lobby + game servers: same `voice-server`, shared `global-data.folder`, unique `server-id` per MC server. One Voice login follows the player across the network.

## Quick start

1. Run `voice-server` (`npm install && npm start`)
2. Put `VoiceMod` on each MC server, set `server-id` + voice-server endpoints
3. Install Voice (PC or Android), open `/voice` in-game for the code, connect

Do not upload `target/`, `build/`, `dist/`, `node_modules/`, `lib/`.
